scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight on a multi-lane urban road and collides with a black and yellow taxi that makes an abrupt U-turn from the opposite direction.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward in its lane and collides with the taxi that completes its U-turn.

adversarials.behavior: The black and yellow taxi makes a U-turn from the opposite direction across the ego's path and comes to a stop after the collision.
The white sedan travels straight in the opposite lane and stops to avoid the collision scene.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a straight multi-lane urban road with median barriers, approaching a black and yellow taxi making a U-turn from the opposite lane; a white sedan is also in the opposite lane behind the taxi.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario terminates upon collision between the ego vehicle and the U-turning taxi.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the left side of the road near the intersection area.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashboard-camera vehicle; black/yellow taxi and white sedan are adversarials. 2. Chronology: Initially ego approaches straight; midpoint taxi begins U-turn across lanes; ending taxi completes U-turn and collides with ego, white sedan stops behind. 3. Evidence: taxi's heading reverses from opposing to same direction as ego; contact occurs at front-right of taxi and front of ego.
